drifted.spec_text: Console output MUST include ANSI color codes to distinguish log levels (e.g., red for error, yellow for warn, green for info, blue/cyan for debug). Design artifacts (data-model.md:14, research.md:21, tasks.md:34) specify the exact code \x1b[33m (standard yellow) for Warn.
drifted.actual: ansi_color() returns \x1b[38;5;208m (256-color orange) for LogLevel::Warn instead of standard yellow \x1b[33m. Error (red), Info (green), and Debug (cyan) match the spec exactly.

drifted.spec_text: Given a component with an ILogger receptacle, When the LoggerComponent is bound via `connect_receptacle`, Then the receptacle's get() returns the ILogger implementation.
drifted.actual: No method named `connect_receptacle` exists anywhere in the codebase; the component-framework macro only generates `connect_receptacle_raw`, which is what tests, the contract doc, and consumers actually use.

conflicts.description: Secondary design artifacts (plan.md, tasks.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, contracts/ilogger.md) refer to the component as LoggerComponentV1 with default constructor new() at path components/logger/v1/src/lib.rs. spec.md and the actual implementation use LoggerComponent with default constructor new_default() at components/logger/src/lib.rs (no v1/ directory exists). The component was apparently renamed/simplified after these design docs were authored and they were never resynced.
